decisive_spans.text: Magnetic resonance imaging of the left foot showed no thickening of the plantar fascia and no signal alteration in adjacent soft tissues or bone marrow

response.rationale: D10 (Plantar Fasciitis) is contradicted by the MRI findings showing no thickening of the plantar fascia. D2 (Calcaneal stress fracture) is not contradicted and is supported by chronic heel pain and bony abnormality, which is a reasonable inference given the presence of a bony protrusion and persistent pain despite other treatments.
